y_failures: Cites Opera Omnia p.189 for black-bile dreams of 'pits, tombs, or feelings of terror and being bound', but the page only mentions smoke, murk and darkness; it also cites Ars medica p.182 for 'lightning, or bitter tastes', which that page does not mention.
reason: Every quotation and case in X (Galen p.189, Artemidorus pp.22–23, Aristotle p.341, Richard's stone-leg case on p.127) appears on its cited page. Y draws on strong medical sources (Constantine/Avicenna, Le Loyer) but attaches dream imagery to Galen pages that those pages do not contain.
